contentHtml:
DLF's ultra-luxury developments — including projects like The Arbour — sit at the top end of Gurgaon's residential market, and interior design costs there are shaped by a different set of expectations than a standard apartment. This guide covers what typically drives cost in a DLF ultra-luxury home, without assuming specifics of any one unit, since layouts and sizes vary by tower and configuration.

What Makes Ultra-Luxury DLF Interiors Different

Homes in DLF's premium developments are generally larger-format (often full-floor or half-floor residences), come with higher base specifications from the developer, and are bought by owners who expect a correspondingly elevated interior finish — natural stone, imported hardware, integrated home automation, and bespoke furniture rather than off-the-shelf modular systems.

What Drives Interior Design Cost at This Tier

  • Material grade. Sintered stone and natural marble instead of laminate or standard quartz, solid veneers instead of printed finishes.
  • Bespoke furniture. Custom-designed pieces built to the specific proportions of large-format rooms, rather than modular or semi-custom systems.
  • Home automation. Integrated lighting, climate, and security systems are far more common at this tier than in a standard 2–3BHK.
  • Scale. Larger floor plates mean more square footage to finish, even before material grade is factored in.
  • Detailing. False ceiling design, cove lighting, and millwork detailing tend to be more elaborate in ultra-luxury briefs.

Typical Cost Expectations

Our full-home turnkey interior design starts at ₹15 Lakhs+ for a standard apartment — ultra-luxury DLF-tier homes, given their larger scale and premium material specification, typically require a meaningfully higher budget than that starting point. The most reliable way to get an accurate number for your specific unit is a site consultation, where we scope the actual floor plate, material choices, and automation requirements together. See our general interior design cost guide for how we structure quotes, and our DLF Gurgaon service area page for our broader work across DLF phases.

Our Approach to Ultra-Luxury Projects

The process stays the same as any Omega Group project — consultation, design and material sign-off, execution by our own team, quality checks at every milestone, and a final walkthrough — but the material sourcing and bespoke furniture design stages typically involve more rounds of sampling and approval, given the finish expectations at this tier.

faqs.question: How much does interior design cost for a DLF The Arbour-tier home?
faqs.answer: It varies significantly by floor plate size and material specification — full-home turnkey design starts at ₹15 Lakhs+ generally, but ultra-luxury DLF-tier homes typically require a meaningfully higher budget given their scale and premium finish expectations. A site consultation gives the most accurate figure.

faqs.question: What makes ultra-luxury interior design different from standard apartment design?
faqs.answer: Primarily material grade (natural stone vs. laminate), more bespoke (rather than modular) furniture, integrated home automation, and larger floor plates to finish.

faqs.question: Do you design homes across all DLF phases in Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: Yes — we work across DLF's residential phases, from established mid-market developments to ultra-luxury projects, adapting our material sourcing and process to the specific brief.

faqs.question: Can I request home automation as part of the interior design?
faqs.answer: Yes — integrated lighting, climate control, and security automation are commonly requested at this tier and are scoped as part of the design consultation.
